environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier) behind Azure Application Gateway with no WAF policy attached. The Application Gateway performs TLS termination with a server certificate but client certificate negotiation is disabled (clientCertEnabled: false on the App Service, no client cert requirement on the gateway listener). The API is publicly accessible on port 443. SQL Server backend is Azure SQL with firewall rule allowing the App Service outbound IPs.

config.gateway: Azure Application Gateway v2 Standard_v2 (no WAF SKU)
